title: Migration program plan for the LFG help desk
scenario: LFG is moving its help desk from Avaya, Genesys, Five9 and an acquired Cisco UCCE/CVP estate to Amazon Connect. As lead architect you write the migration program plan the steering committee signs, working around three contract dates, a year-end blackout, carrier porting lead times and an onshore/offshore/nearshore team.
task: Waves with dates, reasons and entry/exit criteria
Coexistence, migration factory, validation and testing gates
Cutover runbook and an honest rollback plan
RACI with offshore/nearshore teams, hypercare, KT and decommissioning
acceptance: Review-only: rubric scores waves, coexistence, validation, cutover/rollback, delivery model, hypercare
Uses the dates and volumes in inputs/ and names the trade-offs that cannot be avoided

practices.label: Week 9 - offshore leadership, hypercare and KT
